acrewcapital-vanta-com:ashbyhq:1198e8b4-.description: At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. As an Engineering Manager leading our Reporting team, you will lead a newly structured team focused on a critical product area within GRC Program Orchestration. This role represents an exciting opportunity to shape the future of how Vanta customers understand, visualize, and operationalize their compliance and security programs. This team is focused on evolving Vanta’s reporting platform beyond dashboards into a scalable, AI-powered reporting experience. The team owns core initiatives across enterprise reporting, historical analytics, AI-assisted insights, and certified data infrastructure powering in-product experiences. This role sits at the intersection of data products, enterprise scalability, and product innovation. As reporting becomes increasingly foundational to enterprise growth, customer retention, and Vanta’s long-term AI strategy, this role will play a key role in shaping engineering execution, cross-functional alignment, and the long-term technical direction of one of Vanta’s critical product investments. Visit our Vanta Engineering Blog https://www.vanta.com/all-categories/engineering to learn more about what our team is working on! What you’ll do as an Engineering Manager at Vanta: - Build and scale a high-performing team: lead, coach, and grow the team while hiring strategically, identifying operational gaps, and raising the engineering bar - Drive execution across strategic initiatives: Deliver against a multi-quarter roadmap spanning reporting infrastructure, enterprise reporting capabilities, AI-powered insights, and scalable data foundations - Shape technical and product strategy: Partner closely with Product and cross-functional engineering teams to define the long-term vision and architecture for Reporting and data-driven product experiences - Lead through ambiguity and rapid growth: Navigate complex, evolving problem spaces while balancing near-term customer impact with long-term platform investments - Partner cross-functionally: Collaborate deeply with Product, Design, Platform, and business stakeholders to evolve Vanta’s reporting strategy and enterprise data capabilities How to be successful in this role: - Have 4+ more years of professional experience in a full-time engineering management role, with proven experience managing 8-12+ engineers - Have previously managed product engineering teams building a reporting or data visualization product - Possess strong technical depth—ideally as a former senior or staff engineer—with ability to guide data infrastructure and product architecture decisions - Have demonstrated track record of delivering results across multiple workstreams while maintaining quality and team velocity - Have experience setting product and technical strategy in partnership with Product and Design teams - Have participated in developing or driving engineering-wide initiatives in a prior role - Are a strong decision maker who effectively balances ambiguity, available data, speed, and quality - Can influence cross-functional stakeholders and adjacent teams as an effective communicator and story-teller - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact What you can expect as a Vanta'n in Canada: - compasssurgicalpartners-compass-surgical.description: Eastgate Surgery Center Location: Eastgate Surgery Center Address: 4415 Aicholtz Road A, Cincinnati, OH 45245 Eastgate Surgery Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Cincinnati, Ohio. With four procedure rooms, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient procedural care primarily for GI and Endoscopies. Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH and Gastro Health, Eastgate Surgery Center combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting. Procedure Room RN Role Summary The Procedure Room RN provides comprehensive nursing care within an outpatient endoscopy center, supporting patients throughout the pre-admission testing, pre-procedure, procedure, and recovery processes. This role performs preoperative assessments, ensures patients are medically optimized and prepared for their procedure, assists in the procedure rooms, and supports safe, efficient patient care across the center’s three procedure rooms. The Procedure Room RN collaborates closely with CRNAs, proceduralists, and the clinical team to promote patient safety, provide education, identify potential risks, and ensure a seamless patient experience throughout the endoscopy journey. This position is cross-trained to support multiple clinical areas, including Pre-Admission Testing (PAT), pre-op, PACU, and procedure rooms, providing flexibility and coverage to meet the needs of the center. Hours • Monday-Friday • No nights, weekends, holidays, or call What You’ll Do • Perform thorough pre-admission and pre-procedure nursing assessments, including medical history review, medication reconciliation, and verification of required testing and documentation • Identify abnormal findings and communicate concerns to CRNAs, proceduralists, and appropriate members of the care team • Ensure all pre-procedure documentation is complete, accurate, and available prior to the patient’s procedure • Provide nursing care and support in the procedure rooms, assisting with safe and efficient endoscopy procedures • Provide patient care throughout the pre-op and PACU phases, including monitoring, recovery, discharge preparation, and patient education • Educate patients and families regarding the endoscopy experience, expectations, preparation, recovery, and discharge instructions • Collaborate with CRNAs, proceduralists, and the clinical team to ensure patient readiness and continuity of care • Maintain patient privacy, dignity, safety, and age-appropriate care throughout the patient experience • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, staff education, orientation, and ongoing professional development • Demonstrate flexibility by supporting various clinical areas and adjusting workloads based on the needs of the center • Maintain competency across Pre-Admission Testing, pre-op, PACU, and procedure room responsibilities. Obtain and maintain competency in moderate sedation monitoring and safely monitor patients during applicable procedures. What You’ll Bring • Active RN license in Ohio • Current BLS and ACLS certification • Associate’s degree or higher in nursing • Pre-op, PACU, procedure room, endoscopy, ambulatory surgery center, or critical-care experience preferred • Strong assessment skills and ability to recognize and communicate changes in patient condition • Excellent communication skills with a focus on patient advocacy and teamwork • Ability to work collaboratively with CRNAs, proceduralists, and multidisciplinary clinical teams • Comfort using EMR systems and Microsoft Windows-based programs • Willingness and ability to cross-train and provide support throughout the outpatient endoscopy center Physical & Work Environment Requirements • Frequent standing, walking, and patient-care activities • Ability to lift/move up to 30 lbs (occasionally up to 40 lbs; rarely up to 100 lbs) • Regular interaction with patients of varying ages in a fast-paced outpatient clinical environment • Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4924ff58-154f-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.
